2607.10127.title: GAE: Graph-Augmented Evolution for Scientific Discovery via Reinforcement Optimization
2607.10127.paper_summary: Evolutionary program search guided by Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for automated scientific discovery. However, current approaches are fundamentally constrained by three bottlenecks: structurally blind parent selection, sparse whole-program evaluation rewards, and static mutation operators that fail to adapt during search. We present GAE (Graph-Augmented Evolution), a framework that resolves these limitations through a tightly coupled, three-pillar architecture. First, a relational graph neural network (GNN) parses programs into typed computation graphs, producing structure-aware embeddings. Second, an RL-optimized meta-controller leverages these embeddings to replace blind evolutionary sampling with a directed policy, dynamically selecting optimal parents and mutation directions based on reward history. Third, an online GRPO fine-tuning loop continuously updates the LLM mutation operator at test-time using group-normalized evaluation rewards, directly aligning the model's generation distribution with high-fitness structural edits. We evaluate GAE on a challenging scientific discovery task: symbolic regression for complex nonlinear oscillator systems. By transforming stochastic search into a directed, self-improving trajectory, GAE efficiently discovers closed-form physical equations, consistently matching or outperforming static LLM-driven baselines and achieving state-of-the-art out-of-distribution performance.
2607.10127.paper_summary_zh: 進化程序搜索由大型語言模型（LLMs）引導，已成為自動科學發現的一種強大範式。<lb/>然而，當前的方法在根本上受到三個瓶頸的限制：結構盲目的父代選擇、稀疏的整體程序評估獎勵，以及在搜索過程中無法適應的靜態變異運算子。<lb/>我們提出了GAE（圖增強進化），這是一個通過緊密耦合的三大支柱架構來解決這些限制的框架。<lb/>首先，關係圖神經網絡（GNN）將程序解析為類型計算圖，生成結構感知的嵌入。<lb/>其次，經過強化學習優化的元控制器利用這些嵌入，通過有向策略取代盲目的進化採樣，根據獎勵歷史動態選擇最佳父代和變異方向。<lb/>第三，線上GRPO微調迴圈在測試時持續更新LLM變異運算子，使用群組正規化評估獎勵，直接將模型的生成分佈與高適應度的結構編輯對齊。<lb/>我們在一個具有挑戰性的科學發現任務上評估GAE：對複雜非線性振盪器系統的符號回歸。<lb/>通過將隨機搜索轉變為有向的自我改進軌跡，GAE有效地發現了封閉形式的物理方程，持續匹配或超越靜態LLM驅動的基準，並實現了最先進的分佈外性能。
